title: Quick Roasted American Courgettes Skillet
description: A light and flavorful American dish featuring roasted courgettes, this recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner and is FODMAP-friendly. The resinous and flaky texture of the courgettes is emulsified with olive oil and seasonings.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the sliced courgettes with olive oil, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Spread the courgettes out in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
While the courgettes are roasting, heat the garlic-infused oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the roasted courgettes to the skillet and toss to combine with the garlic-infused oil.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the chopped fresh parsley and grated cheddar cheese until the cheese is melted and the mixture is well combined.
Serve the Quick Roasted American Courgettes Skillet hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
